verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical, and both share the same faults. The product can is pushed into the top-right corner instead of being the hero. The three badges sit in an uneven cluster, with the SUNSET SALE ribbon jammed underneath AWARD WINNING. The broken 'missing asset' placeholder crowds the legal text, and the headline is so long and so large that it dominates the whole canvas. B wins only because its SOLSTICE logo and sun keep a readable size. In A the logo shrinks to a tiny, nearly illegible mark, which weakens the brand.
